services.desc: For photo examples of weddings held at The Byrdcliffe Barn, The Loom Room and White Pines, please click here. The Byrdcliffe Theater, originally conceived as an art school and library, is an original Byrdcliffe Arts Colony structure. The intimate space seats 100 people, with 60 movable seats at stage level and 40 seats in the balcony. The lobby, featuring a large, mid-twentieth century mural painted by artist Arthur Zaidenburg, is the perfect location for a dramatic reception. The adjoining stone terrace provides a pleasant outdoor gathering space. In its one-hundred-year history, the theater has hosted many dance, drama, opera, and other musical performances. services.desc: Step inside White Pines, the original home of Byrdcliffe’s founders, Ralph and Jane Whitehead, and discover how this 1902 utopian Arts and Crafts colony began. Group Tours The Group Tour includes a guided tour of White Pines home and a Self-Guided Walking Tour & History Map of the Byrdcliffe Colony Campus that you can use either before or after your White Pines Tour. Private Tours If you cannot make a scheduled Group Tour, or would like to gather some friends for a special occasion, we offer a Private Tour of White Pines scheduled at your convenience for $250.
